note: The Agents SDK honors OPENAI_BASE_URL — zero code — or a custom client for finer control.
code:
# Zero-code path: the Agents SDK reads OPENAI_BASE_URL.
#   export OPENAI_BASE_URL="{{baseURL}}/w/{{app}}/openai/v1"

# Or set a custom client explicitly:
import os
from openai import AsyncOpenAI
from agents import Agent, Runner, set_default_openai_client

set_default_openai_client(
    AsyncOpenAI(
        base_url="{{baseURL}}/w/{{app}}/openai/v1",
        api_key=os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"],
    ),
    use_for_tracing=False,
)

agent = Agent(name="assistant", instructions="Be concise.")
result = Runner.run_sync(agent, "Why is the sky blue?")
